description: We are EcoShield Rwanda, a GLOC Rwanda Top 5 team using NASA satellite data, AI, IoT, and drones to predict climate risks and natural disasters. We're developing an early-warning system for floods, landslides, and droughts. We seek teammates skilled in Python, AI/ML, GIS, remote sensing, web development, UI/UX, and data analysis. Join us to turn space technology into real-world solutions! 🚀
summary:
ECOSHIELD RWANDA  is an AI-powered disaster early-warning and environmental monitoring system developed by Team Apollo 11 to help protect vulnerable communities in Rwanda from floods, landslides, droughts, wildfires, and environmental degradation.

Our project combines NASA Earth observation resources, solar-powered IoT ground station concepts, drone reconnaissance, and artificial intelligence into one integrated platform for disaster risk monitoring and response.

Through an interactive map of Rwanda, authorities can identify high-risk areas, examine satellite and sensor evidence, request drone inspections, and receive AI-assisted risk assessments with recommended actions. Our prototype also demonstrates how emergency alerts and evacuation guidance could reach communities before disasters escalate.

Unlike systems that rely on a single information source, EcoShield is designed to combine satellite observations with local ground measurements and aerial verification for more informed decision-making.

**Our mission is to transform environmental data into actionable intelligence, helping Rwanda reduce disaster risks, protect livelihoods, strengthen climate resilience, and save lives.**

**EcoShield Rwanda — Detect Early. Verify Smartly. Protect Lives.**

EcoShield Rwanda — Project Details

Team Apollo 11 | NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

1. The Problem

Rwanda frequently experiences floods, landslides, droughts, and other environmental disasters that threaten lives, homes, and livelihoods.

During the May 2023 floods and landslides:

  • 131 people lost their lives.
  • Over 18,000 people were left homeless.
  • Approximately US$187 million was recorded in damage and losses.
  • Rwanda does not have enough weather stations to monitor each district hazard based information hince unpredicted hazards that takes lives.

The main challenge: Environmental information is often difficult to combine, verify locally, and turn into timely warnings for communities.

2. Our Solution

EcoShield Rwanda is an AI-powered disaster monitoring and early-warning platform that connects NASA satellite observations, IoT ground sensors, drones, and AI in one system.

It helps authorities identify dangerous areas, examine evidence, verify potential threats, and make informed decisions to protect communities.

NORMALY PEAPLE DIE BUT OUR SYSTEM IS FOR ENHANCEMENT AND SUPPORT RWANDA EXISTING PROJECT

3. How EcoShield Works

  1. Monitor: NASA satellite data and proposed IoT sensors provide environmental observations.
  2. Detect: AI-assisted analysis identifies possible environmental risks.
  3. Visualize: An interactive Rwanda map highlights risk areas.
  4. Verify: Operators can request drone inspections for additional evidence.
  5. Analyze: The system presents risk assessments and recommended actions.
  6. Respond: Authorized authorities can coordinate warnings and evacuation measures.

4. What We Developed

Our digital prototype demonstrates:

  • An interactive Rwanda disaster-risk dashboard.
  • District-level risk visualization and evidence review.
  • An AI-assisted assessment interface.
  • A simulated drone inspection workflow.
  • A 3D disaster monitoring and response simulation.
  • A proposed community emergency alert process.

5. Technologies Used

Software and programming:

  • React, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • Node.js and Express for backend development.
  • Three.js for 3D visualization.
  • Google AI Studio and AI-assisted development tools.

NASA resources:

  • GPM IMERG — rainfall estimates.
  • NASA LHASA — landslide hazard information.

Proposed hardware:

  • Arduino/ESP32 microcontrollers.
  • Rainfall, water-level, and soil-moisture sensors.
  • Solar panels and wireless communication modules.
  • Camera-equipped drones.

6. What Makes EcoShield Innovative?

  • Integrated intelligence: Combines satellite, ground, and aerial observations.
  • Local verification: Uses drone inspection to investigate uncertain risks.
  • AI-assisted decisions: Converts complex information into understandable findings.
  • Affordable design: Proposes solar-powered, modular IoT monitoring stations.
  • User-friendly platform: Provides a simple, district-focused command center.
  • Community focus: Connects environmental monitoring to practical response actions.

7. Expected Impact

EcoShield aims to:

  • Support earlier disaster risk identification.
  • Improve emergency preparedness and response.
  • Help protect lives, homes, and agricultural livelihoods.
  • Reduce potential economic losses.
  • Strengthen climate resilience in vulnerable communities.
  • Improve coordination between authorities and communities.

8. Future Development

Our next steps are to:

  1. Build and test physical IoT ground stations.
  2. Integrate operational NASA data and drone observations.
  3. Validate risk assessments against real environmental conditions.
  4. Conduct pilot testing with relevant local authorities.
  5. Expand monitoring to additional districts.

Our Vision

EcoShield Rwanda transforms intelligence from space into actionable information for communities on Earth.

Detect Early. Verify Smartly. Protect Lives.

Note: Our current project is a digital prototype. Physical deployments, fully operational drone integration, and live community warning services are planned future developments.
